verdicts.reason: A keeps the original split layout intact: logo, SAVE badge, headline, body and CTA in order on the left, with the coffee bag as the hero on the right. Its only flaws are minor: the photo panel now floats with uneven top/bottom gaps while running to the right edge, and the logo wordmark is tiny. B is broken. The photo panel is an empty blurred box because the product bag has shrunk to an icon-sized thumbnail at the bottom. The CTA has jumped above the headline, which breaks the reading order. The badge floats loose under the body copy, and the logo is reduced to a small stamp.

A is unusable. The CTA has shrunk to an illegible sliver in the bottom-left corner, so the button no longer reads. The product bag and logo are tiny thumbnails jammed beside it, and the right half is an empty blurred photo panel with no product. The SAVE badge is now bigger than the CTA, which inverts the hierarchy, and the headline sits too close to the left canvas edge. B is a faithful rearrangement of the original with clear hierarchy and the bag as hero. Its only flaws are minor: the floating photo panel's edges are inconsistent and the logo text is tiny.
